dataset.phenotype_positive_definition: MIC above the cut of its agent: ciprofloxacin 1, meropenem 2, cefotaxime, ceftazidime, gentamicin and tetracycline 4 mg/L; technical cuts, not clinical breakpoints or epidemiological cut-offs
dataset.phenotype_source: the two-category readings of mic_two_categories.csv, written as 0 or 1 by build_derived_tables.py

lineage_selection.note: permutation p-values of the lineage share; the smallest attainable p-value is 1/(n_perm + 1), so a panel of m agents needs n_perm large enough that this floor is below alpha/m for a single agent to be selectable

lineage_evidence.note: e-value in the betting sense of Vovk and Wang, not the BLAST expectation value and not the E-value of VanderWeele and Ding

family.collection_generalization_rule: requires complete trait and lineage data for the supplied finite collections
family.method: Benjamini-Yekutieli within each component family, on nominal percentile-bootstrap p-values; the step-up admits any dependence between agents
family.note: discoveries have the stated labelled-subset scope. The effective count is the participation ratio of the panel correlation eigenspectrum; a panel whose agents share a resistance mechanism is worth fewer independent tests than it has columns

lineage_label_availability.note: the decomposition describes isolates with an observed trait and a lineage label. Selection tests are diagnostics: significance detects an association, while equal coverage or nonsignificance cannot establish representativeness. Complete outcome and label data alone support generalization to the supplied finite collections; no field supports extrapolation beyond those collections

cefotaxime.shared_support_definition: unweighted mean of the two collection-specific proportions
cefotaxime.convention: a lineage absent from one collection is given that collection's rate equal to the observed one; this makes within_lineage a function of shared lineages only, and under this declared convention, and allocates the whole contribution of a lineage seen in one collection only in composition, where it is reported apart as nonshared, with composition_shared the remainder
cefotaxime.note: the typed difference is described, not explained: it applies to isolates with observed traits and lineage labels. The observed collection difference is reported separately; neither component is a causal effect

results.estimand: lineage share of the call among the represented lineages
results.interval_kind: 95% interval for the represented lineages (isolates drawn again, lineages fixed)
results.assumptions: Isolates of a lineage drawn independently from its distribution, whatever their sampling units share; the p-value assumes lineage labels exchangeable within the collection under the null.
results.conclusion: Not established on this collection (share 0.020; 95 % interval 0.000 to 0.052; p 0.017; q 0.125; lower bound 0.000; lower confidence limit 0.000).

results.estimand: lineage share of the latent ordering
results.interval_kind: bounds the readings allow; not a confidence interval; lower end established by the readings; upper end sharp
results.assumptions: Every reading holds the latent MIC it stands for (a call: the side of its cut-off); the latent MIC is continuous within a stratum; lineages of one isolate set aside. No distributional form for the latent values. The bounds are sharp where the distinct readings of each stratum are disjoint; overlapping readings are merged into one cell and the bounds then hold but may not be attained.

results.estimand: lineage share of the latent ordering

The limit also assumes readings independent between isolates, whatever their sampling units share.
